pills.text: BRITISH LABELS MAKE RULERS RELIGION THE CLOCK OF HISTORY.

jati proliferation → local negotiation culture: oral/textual traditions + material practice + cross-regional exchange
VERDICT: dates organise; processes explain; regional change is asynchronous.
